subject: grouped and faceted dotplot: joining points by lines, ordered by y

messages.author: 467324c7303934a0
messages.subject: grouped and faceted dotplot: joining points by lines, ordered by y
parts:
In this classic plot of the barley data, of yield by variety and color, faceted by site,
I'd like to join the points with lines in each panel for the variety - year combinations
from bottom to top (ordered by y=variety)

data(barley, package="lattice")
library(ggplot2)
gg <- ggplot(data=barley, aes(x=yield, y=variety, color=year)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~site)

gg

The following gives me lines connecting the points, but ordered from left to right,
by x=yield, not what I want.  How can I gent what I want?

gg +  geom_line(aes(x=yield, y=variety, group=year))


-Michael

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: grouped and faceted dotplot: joining points by lines, ordered by y
parts:
Is this what you were after?

ggplot(barley, aes(x = variety, y = yield, color = year)) +
geom_point() +
geom_line(aes(group = year)) +
coord_flip() +
facet_wrap(~ site)

This is one case where coord_flip() and facet_wrap() play nice with
each other. You need the group aesthetic to produce lines across
factor levels, which works most easily when the factor is on the
x-axis. The coord_flip() call exchanges the x and y axes after the
points and lines are produced.

Dennis
